mapper.select: select id, page_code, phone, qr_code, show_online_service, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from free_query_page_config order by page_code
mapper.insert: insert into free_query_page_config (page_code, phone, qr_code, show_online_service, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{pageCode}, #{phone}, #{qrCode}, #{showOnlineService}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update phone = values(phone), qr_code = values(qr_code), show_online_service = values(show_online_service), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = values(update_time)
